hero.headline: We build the [light]quiet[/light] machinery behind loud products
hero.headlinePlain: We build the quiet machinery behind loud products
hero.sub: A senior-only product studio that builds and owns the parts of software other people can’t see — and won’t touch. Design, engineering, cloud and AI, from first prototype to production.

endcard.tagline: The quiet machinery behind loud products.

projects.name: Merlin

projects.name: Maquette

projects.name: Facet

services.heading: Eight disciplines, [light]one team[/light]
services.lead: The full surface area of a modern product company — from the first sketch to the on-call rotation that keeps it alive at 3am.

items.name: Interface Design
items.description: UI and brand systems that feel inevitable. Visual identity, product surfaces, and design tokens built to scale across teams.

items.name: Engineering
items.description: Web and mobile applications written by senior engineers. Type-safe, observable, and built to be maintained, not rewritten.

items.name: Cloud & Infra
items.description: AWS and GCP architectures, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code. Predictable cost, predictable uptime.

items.name: Architecture
items.description: Systems design for products that need to last. We choose the boring technology so you can take the exciting risks.

items.name: Security
items.description: Threat modelling, code audits, and compliance readiness. Built-in, not bolted-on.

items.name: Integrations
items.description: Payment rails, messaging, identity, AI providers, and legacy systems. We make foreign services feel native.

items.name: AI Engineering
items.description: Production LLM pipelines with retrieval, evaluation, and guardrails. AI that ships, not AI that demos.

items.name: Care & Support
items.description: Ongoing partnership after launch. Monitoring, on-call rotation, and a real human at the other end of the line.

studio.title: A short note
studio.note: We are a senior-only studio. We build the quiet layer that carries the most value — precise, restrained, and a little rare. If it feels quiet, exact, and uncommon, it is right.

process.heading: Four phases, [light]no surprises[/light]
process.lead: Our engagements run lean. Small teams, short feedback loops, and demos every Friday. The process is the product.
process.label: How we work · Four phases, no surprises

phases.name: Discovery
phases.description: Two weeks of deep listening. We map users, constraints, and the gap between where you are and where you want to be.
phases.tags: Stakeholder interviews · Competitive audit · Technical scoping

phases.name: Architecture
phases.description: Information architecture, systems design, and a north-star prototype. Decisions get cheap before code gets expensive.

phases.name: Build
phases.description: Two-week sprints. Demo every Friday. You watch the product grow in your hands, not in a status doc.

phases.name: Launch & Care
phases.description: We don’t disappear at v1. SLOs, monitoring, growth experiments, and a team that picks up the phone.

items.quote: “They write code the way good lawyers write contracts. Every line is there for a reason. We’ve worked with three vendors before them. None compared.”
items.name: Ahmed AbdelGawad

items.quote: “Architectural runs, apparel batches and merch jobs on one queue — they understood our floor before we finished explaining it. Production finally feels coordinated, not chaotic.”
items.name: Abdelrahman Tarek
